note: Pinned model-weight manifest. Every file is identified by URL, revision, size, and sha256. flake.nix fetches these as fixed-output derivations for the desktop bundle; the browser downloader verifies the same hashes before caching. Regenerate an entry with: node scripts/update-model-manifest.mjs --id <id>. Empty sha256 values mean the entry is not yet pinned — both Nix and the runtime refuse to use it.
